Icon proposals · round 3

Regulation map + fish, all in the linocut craft the owner liked in round 2. Each is cut the way a lino block is: tapered gouges, hand-nicked edges, two or three inks. Status colours are the app map's own tokens, used once per icon. Each has a 16/32 px cut that keeps the same mark. Folders hold icon.svg, foreground.svg (adaptive 108 canvas, art inside the 66 safe circle), background.txt, monochrome.svg and favicon.svg. Proposals only; nothing is wired in. Built by round3/build.mjs.

Sectioned band

The trout is the map

Linocut, map engravinground3/2-map-trout/
